probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis is fundamentally flawed. The reasoning in the prompt text 'electron is about 9.11e-27 kg; proton' actually contains a typo in the exponent (-27 instead of -31), but the analysis incorrectly labels this as an explicit contradiction where the agent claims electron > proton. In reality, 9.11e-27 is still numerically less than 1.67e-27 even with the typo, so the 'contradiction' cited (electron < proton) matches the scientific fact (electron < proton). The real issue is a factual error in the magnitude of the electron's mass (order of 10^-31, not 10^-27) and a missing exponent in the prompt text itself, not a logical mismatch in reasoning. The confidence in the original claim was 0.95, which is incorrect because the premise itself is wrong. Therefore, the proposed analysis fails to identify the actual nature of the error (factual calculation/data hallucination) and misinterprets the logic flow.
